ddompigdampgdumpfdampdullgloomyandedampo.word: D. dompig damp, G. dumpf damp, dull, gloomy, and E. damp, or rather

definitions.text: A dull, gloomy state of the mind; sadness; melancholy; low spirits; despondency; ill humor; -- now used only in the plural. March slowly on in solemn dump. Hudibras. Doleful dumps the mind oppress. Shak. I was musing in the midst of my dumps. Bunyan. originally belong to it. "Holland's translation of Livy represents the Romans as being `in the dumps' after the battle of Cannæ." Trench.
A melancholy strain or tune in music; any tune. [Obs.] "Tune a deploring dump." "Play me some merry dump." Shak.
An old kind of dance. [Obs.] Nares.
